Eva is interested in swimming. Owen's favorite animal is the elephant. There are always many people at the neighborhood station. What's more, a stone fountain stands in the park.

Owen hopes to visit Tokyo one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the post office by bike. Last Wednesday, Owen and Eva went to the post office. What's more, you can see the whole city from the tower.
They took many photos at the neighborhood station. Both of them like salad and coffee. Life is full of small surprises. Also, hang your coat on the hanger by the door.
Owen wrote about the day in the diary. Owen is going to travel to Tokyo in March. Owen wants to be a driver in the future.
